fg-disabled.comment: --form-input-fg-disabled (form.scss:12, #484741). Also drives -webkit-text-fill-color on disabled text inputs.

radius.comment: --form-input-radius (form.scss:14). No radius primitive scale exists yet; raw geometry.

height.comment: --form-input-height default (form.scss:19). No space.* step matches 2.9rem; component dimension, not forced onto the spacing scale.

outline-color.comment: --form-input-outline-color default (form.scss:24, $gray-light). Also the resting focus outline read by checkbox/radio/toggle input:focus (form.scss:277) and [type=file]:focus (form.scss:190).

item-margin.comment: --form-item-margin default (form.scss:22, 1rem). Also read outside .form nesting by the checkbox/radio/toggle label margin-left (form.scss:265) and the flex/inline/side-legend gap declarations — see the custom-property-scope trap in contracts notes.

font-size.comment: --form-button-font-size default (form.scss:21, 1.05rem). Aliases button/small/font-size rather than duplicating the value — commit 7bafeb8ead's documented intent: a plain [type=submit] in a form renders at Button's small size. If Button's small size changes, Forms follows.

background.comment: --form-input-bg on text-input :focus (form.scss:49). NEEDS-ARCHITECT: one hex step from color.white (#FFFFFF) — within the ~2-step consolidation threshold, but rgb(254) vs rgb(255) is not a computed no-op, so left as raw geometry (not a primitive) pending an architect call on whether to consolidate to color.white or mint a gray.10/gray.25 primitive.

input-height.comment: --form-input-height under .form--large (form.scss:392). Component dimension, no matching space.* step.

input-font-size.comment: --form-input-font-size under .form--large (form.scss:393, 1.2rem). Note the misleading step name — font-size.150's VALUE is 1.2rem, not 1.5rem.

label-font-size.comment: --form-label-font-size under .form--large (form.scss:394, 1.1rem). Reuses the existing primitive rather than minting a duplicate font-size.110.

button-font-size.comment: --form-button-font-size under .form--large (form.scss:395, 1.25rem). Aliases button/font-size (Button's own default/medium size) — same documented pairing as form/button/font-size ↔ button/small/font-size.

track-off.comment: Toggle resting background (form.scss:336, $gray-light) — the un-checked track color. Only track-off/track-on/knob are tokenized; the knob's size, position and 'on off' glyph geometry are load-bearing and stay un-tokenized (see geometryNotTokenized).

track-on.comment: Toggle input:checked background (form.scss:374, $primary). Note !important on --form-input-bg-disabled (form.scss:137) beats this when the toggle is also disabled — a disabled+checked toggle renders gray, not gold.

legend-font-size.comment: Side-legend legend font-size (form.scss:457) is currently a literal 1rem instead of var(--form-label-font-size), despite the same rule block using that var at :242 for the top-legend case — literal-vs-token drift. Tokenized here as the fix target for the SCSS swap; value is unchanged (1rem).

legend-font-weight.comment: Side-legend legend font-weight (form.scss:458) is a literal 600, matching the existing font-weight.medium-bold primitive by value. This represents the DECLARED CSS value only — the legend inherits Roboto (served at 300/400/500/700/900, no 600 face), so the rendered face is actually 700 or 500 via font-matching. Do not change the declared value to 700/500 without measuring which face Storybook actually loads (Antonio-class caveat).

background.comment: select[multiple] background (form.scss:214, #fff). Distinguishes the bordered listbox archetype from the arrow-decorated single select.

line-height.comment: select[multiple] option rows (form.scss:213). Tier-3 literal by architect call 2026-08-14 — no line-height primitive minted for a single-use value.
